note: Both sets repeat claims heavily and both misstate the 10-gram figure as a friction limit at the axial rotation points, when the text calls it the maximum pull force required per louver. Set A binds the key numbers (2500 g cool/martensite, 2900 g heated/austenite, 400 g total actuation force, 15-20C austenite range, 200C-to-cryogenic martensite range) to the correct wire and phases, and includes a correctly bound per-louver 10 g claim. Set B adds two vague phase claims (value just "Martensite" or "Austenite"), a trivial "value" attribute claim, and an invented "< 10 g" friction criterion, so it accumulates more misread and unsupported claims despite one extra valid claim (electrically induced contraction). Set A's main flaw is one spliced, non-verbatim quote and one claim that wrongly says the 2500 g condition is unspecified.
